descriptions.w3d_d31g_landmark_setup_800601a0: Level object setup: assigns the two names from the description (+96, +92) and uppercases the second, computes the position through 0x800b43f8 and the matrix from 0x800b8c50, the scaled size with the context scale at +372, rotates by the three angles at +68, packs the colour from +56, then by the 7-character prefix either loads the model, places it, creates a light from the 0x80413a68 type bound to it, or creates the effect 0x800e5ca4 from the name suffix.
